# data/silver_labels/ — FS matcher training labels (external, VM-only PHI)

Referenced in `docs/Data-Contract.md`'s `data/` directory audit table
(`data/silver_labels/`, "VM-only PHI input, gitignored") and
`docs/FS-Matcher-Production-Guide.md`.

**Not generated by the pipeline.** These are "silver" labels — high-
precision deterministic confirmations used as a proxy for ground truth (not
hand-adjudicated like `data/raw/gold_labels.csv`) — externally curated and
placed here.

- **Consumer:** `src/models/fs_matcher/train.py::_load_silver_labels`
  (`python -m src.models.fs_matcher.train`)
- **Default file:** `silver_labels_v1_2026_06_21.csv` — this is the exact
  path `train.py` reads when no `--silver-labels` flag is passed
  (`s.project_root / "data" / "silver_labels" / "silver_labels_v1_2026_06_21.csv"`).
  If you add a newer version, either name it to match that default or always
  pass `--silver-labels <path>` explicitly.
- **Naming convention:** `silver_labels_v{N}_{YYYY_MM_DD}.csv` — bump `N` for
  a new labeling pass, keep old versions around for reproducibility of past
  training runs (referenced by their own `.meta.json` provenance).

⚠️ **Historical note:** this file used to live at `data/raw/silver_labels.csv`
(wrong location/name relative to `train.py`'s default) — moved here to match
the code. If you're restoring from an old backup or a teammate's copy, check
you're not reintroducing the stale path.

PHI — gitignored, never committed, VM-populated only.
